summary: Static technical audit against the expanded file (node scripts/expand-md.js — no-op: zero {{prompt:}} markers, zero inline **Prompt** fences, confirmed by grep) + four compendiums (platform_and_boundaries [47 rules], research_claims [14 rules], prompts [44 rules, technical-mechanical scope], pedagogy [technical subset: 16/22/23/36/37]). This is the M3-close consolidation/recognition closer (near-half laws + governor + two 2026-07-10 control-pair recognition chunks + the woven-in engine-map SVG). It carries NO fenced/registry prompts, NO [Skill: ] bracket references, and NO URLs of any kind (grepped body + maintainer block) — so the prompts ledger and URL-liveness surface resolve N/A/empty by content-absence, correctly, for a pure lecture. Three platform-adjacent claims were checked rather than defaulted to N/A: (1) 'CLAUDE.md and CLAUDE.local.md steer because the agent conditions every move on what they hold' (line 108) — matches check_platform_and_boundaries.md §6d's auto-load surface (verified-fresh, dated 2026-05-24, 47 days old, under the §4b 60-day rot window) and correctly scoped since the completeness-review Edit (2026-07-02) already fixed the prior overclaim; (2) 'plan mode' (line 106) named correctly, no mechanics asserted, nothing to get wrong; (3) 'the test-strategy skill' (line 112) references the student's own M3-built artifact, consonant with the real `test-strategy` skill family (test-strategy / test-strategy-picoshare / test-strategy-codesearch / test-strategy-lemmings all exist on this machine) and not a bracket-style skill invocation needing the rule-3 existence check. Two maintainer-block-only citations (Chris Argyris/double-loop-learning `[cultural-vocab]`, closed-loop-controller 'un-attributed by design') were checked against check_research_claims.md §1's cultural-vocab carve-out and §7's Vision×Detail split — both PASS, both already reasoned through in the file's own 'Frameworks riffed on' note (attribution budget explicitly spent elsewhere, in `skills-from-the-frontier.md`, per `check_writing.md` #11). Registry-scope sanity check (§26): confirmed this file is link-walked from the TRAININGS registry, not a disk orphan — `earn-the-trust.md` links it, `training-architecture.md` and `trainer-modules.md` both reference it by name. SVG-derivation sanity check: only one `id` attribute exists in the figure (`id="lh-wall"`), correctly re-prefixed from the `the-whole-map.md` parent's `wm-` per the maintainer block's own claim — no leftover `wm-` ids. One disclosed, non-blocking staleness item (§24a): the Quality stamp (`compendium-audited 2026-07-08, slides@47f3357`) predates four commits that touched this file (05fbd36, 6692710, 327615a, 66c9863 — current HEAD), including the two 2026-07-10 unreviewed passes this very audit is reviewing. This is not a hidden defect — the file's own maintainer block self-flags it twice ('Re-audit before ship'), and `curriculum/trainings/agentic-engineering-101/pre-cohort-todos.md` already carries an open action item naming this exact file for re-stamp once judged. No blocking findings.
